Section 3, assigning the listed departments and agencies the functions required by the Federal Advisory Committee Act: Executive Order 11948 of December 20, 1976, section 4(b), states that Executive Order No. 11827, as amended, is superseded, and section 5 states that the order is effective December 31, 1976. Item (4) of section 2 continued the Energy Research and Development Advisory Council until January 5, 1977. Executive Order 11915 of May 10, 1976 abolishes that Council and rescinds section 2(4) of this order, so this item ended 1976-05-10, before the supersession of the rest of the order.

Section 4 provides that advisory committees created by the President before January 5, 1973 and not continued by section 1 terminate as of January 5, 1975 unless sooner terminated under the Federal Advisory Committee Act. The provision operated on its stated date, 1975-01-05 (inclusive reading; exclusive reading one day earlier), and no earlier termination is held.

conflict_resolutions.EVENT_BEFORE_SIGNING: The machine items dated 1963 to 1974 are the establishing orders of the listed committees, which predate this order by definition. They are earlier instruments, not later events or ends of this order.

research_rationale:
EO 11827 (signed 1975-01-04), Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, continues eleven committees (section 1) and five committees (section 2) until January 5, 1977 unless sooner terminated, assigns functions (section 3) and terminates unlisted pre-1973 committees as of January 5, 1975 (section 4). The inventory of 15 clauses was confirmed against the held Federal Register text; items (1) to (5) of section 1 and item (1) of section 2 share the spans of their lead clauses as the dossier cut them. EO 11948 (1976-12-20) supersedes the order effective 1976-12-31 (whole-order end); EO 11915 (1976-05-10) rescinded section 2(4) earlier, so that item ended 1976-05-10; section 4 ended 1975-01-05 by its own terms. A held-text search by number for each of the fourteen establishing orders found later orders 11937, 11945 and 11946 that amend three committees' own establishing orders and 11948, 11915; none terminates a committee sooner or amends EO 11827.
